lookup_INT_TO_FLOAT_MAPPER: lookup INT_TO_FLOAT_MAPPER to convert a 4bit model name to its float16 equivalent
lookup_FLOAT_TO_INT_MAPPER: lookup FLOAT_TO_INT_MAPPER to find the 4bit Unsloth model key for a given float model name
lookup_MAP_TO_UNSLOTH_16bit: lookup MAP_TO_UNSLOTH_16bit to map an official or quantized model name to the optimized Unsloth 16bit version
lookup_FLOAT_TO_FP8_BLOCK_MAPPER: lookup FLOAT_TO_FP8_BLOCK_MAPPER to find the FP8 block-quantized Unsloth model for a given float model name
lookup_FLOAT_TO_FP8_ROW_MAPPER: lookup FLOAT_TO_FP8_ROW_MAPPER to find the FP8 row-quantized Unsloth model for a given float model name
